maya_support: Hey team — customer ingrid_acme reports bulk VAT ID upload failures. They uploaded a CSV (~120 rows) to the bulk-resale-cert endpoint and 18 rows were marked invalid. Customer sees a mix of VIES errors and our validator returning "invalid". They need reverse-charge applied for those invoices by EOD. Ticket #T-9227 with the CSV attached.

maya_support: Repro steps I used:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/vat/bulk-validate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -F 'file=@acme_vat_batch.csv'
2) Wait for job -> returns job_id
3) GET /v1/billing/vat/jobs/{job_id} -> shows 18 failures with message "VIES: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE / 503" or "FORMAT_MISMATCH" for a few.

maya_support: Sample failing row (copied from CSV):
```
customer_id,company_name,vat_id,country
C-1948,Acme Europe,GB999999973,GB
```

oliver_billing: Noted. Two quick things:
- We should confirm whether GB IDs are being routed through VIES (UK left EU) — we had special handling that falls back to manual checks. If the job hit VIES for GB it can return odd responses.
- For the ones with FORMAT_MISMATCH, customers sometimes include whitespace or punctuation — we can strip/normalize on import.

sara_engineer: I pulled logs for job_id=job_20260301_44. We see a burst of outbound requests to VIES ~120 requests within ~30s. VIES responded with intermittent 503s and 429s. Our current bulk validator does naive parallel requests (concurrency=50) which triggered remote rate limits.

sara_engineer: Proposed fix (short-term hotfix):
- throttle outbound VIES calls to concurrency=8
- add exponential backoff on 503/429 with up to 3 retries
- cache positive validations for 24h (in-memory) during the bulk job
I can push this as a hotfix to staging and then prod in ~2 hours. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

frank_escalations: Customer deadline is EOD. Can billing allow invoices to be processed with a "validation_pending" flag so we don't block payments? We'll need a list of affected account IDs.

oliver_billing: We can set a temporary flag to allow invoices to proceed but mark them so we require downstream manual evidence upload. We'll limit to the affected accounts and add a note on the invoice: "VAT reverse-charge pending verification. Contact billing@redwood.ai if missing."

maya_support: Sending affected accounts now (from the ticket CSV): C-1948, C-1972, C-1980, C-2001, C-2023, C-2055, C-2077, C-2102, C-2111, C-2133, C-2139, C-2154, C-2181, C-2199, C-2210, C-2234, C-2241, C-2256

oliver_billing: Got it. I'll mark those 18 customers with billing.allow_invoices=true and billing.vat_status=verification_pending. I'll also add a UI note so CS agents see the pending state.

sara_engineer: Patch is ready and tested locally. Deploy plan:
- merge -> staging -> smoke test (10 min)
- deploy to prod with a small canary (5% of bulk jobs) and monitor VIES 503/429 rate for 15 min
I expect the overall failure count for bulk jobs to drop to <2%. If that looks good I'll ramp to 100%.

maya_support: Thanks. Can you also add a CSV-normalizer step in the pipeline? Quick regex to trim and uppercase VAT IDs would have fixed several "FORMAT_MISMATCH" cases.

sara_engineer: Yep adding normalization now. Example normalizer we use in node:
```
function normalizeVat(v) {
  return v.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '').toUpperCase();
}
```

maya_support: Customer asked if we can re-run their failed rows only after the fix — they don't want to re-upload everything.

sara_engineer: We have job-level visibility. Once deployed I can queue a retry job that only includes the previously failed rows. I'll coordinate with support to trigger it.

frank_escalations: Please also include a note in the ticket to ask customers to attach evidence (resale certificate) for the ones that ultimately still fail. We should avoid revenue disruption.

oliver_billing: Done — flags set and invoice flow unblocked. I've DM'd finance to expect manual evidence for those account IDs.

vies-bot: [VIES] 2026-03-01 15:12:20 — service status: intermittent 503s from region EU-Central

sara_engineer: Hotfix rolled to prod canary at 15:29; monitoring now. Early numbers: the job that previously failed now shows 1 failure (was 18). Re-running the failed-only job for ingrid_acme... queued as retry_job_879.

maya_support: Customer confirms they received invoices and will wait for final verification. They're re-running on our side. :white_check_mark:

frank_escalations: Great work. After this stabilizes can we add an admin control to re-run failed rows (single button) so CS doesn't need to ask eng every time? Filing product request PRD-334.

sara_engineer: Agreed — filing followup ticket for bulk job re-run button and better failure visibility. For now I've queued the re-run and will post results in the ticket when complete. :eyes:

maya_support: Closing the loop here — will follow up in ticket #T-9227 with results. Thanks all!
